guitar.notes: Nick Drake's Guild M-20 acoustic is well documented as his primary guitar, central to his fingerstyle/open-tuning sound.

tone.target: dry fingerpicked acoustic folk, close-mic intimacy
tone.profile: dry fingerpicked acoustic folk, close-mic intimacy
tone.summary: The rig simulates a highly intimate, fingerpicked acoustic folk sound by using the cleanest pre-amp (Comp) and a low-gain, vintage amp model (US Deluxe), paired with a small cab to maintain natural string detail. Modulation and heavy effects are avoided.

rig.name: Nick Drake - Pink Moon - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain intimacy.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for clean recordings.

blocks.purpose: Smooth transients and provide a gentle boost for acoustic clarity.
blocks.gap: None. Compression is key to intimate, controlled folk tones.

blocks.purpose: Keep the signal completely clean and transparent.
blocks.gap: The goal is pure acoustic tone, so all gain stages are bypassed.

blocks.purpose: Provide a warm, vintage clean tone suitable for acoustic emulation.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the cleanest option available; settings are dialed back to minimize coloration.

blocks.purpose: Simulate a small, close-mic recording environment, preserving natural string detail.
blocks.gap: A 2x12 cab is ideal for intimate, non-aggressive tones.

blocks.purpose: Slightly enhance the fundamental frequencies and air for clarity without sounding artificial.
blocks.gap: Subtle EQ adjustments are necessary to bring out the 'ping' of acoustic strings.

blocks.purpose: Avoid any filtering or sweeping effects to maintain natural tone.
blocks.gap: The target sound explicitly avoids all wah/filter sweeps.

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone completely dry and natural.
blocks.gap: No modulation is desired for this intimate folk sound.

blocks.purpose: Avoid any echo or repetition to maintain dryness.
blocks.gap: The instructions explicitly call for removing delay and keeping it dry.

blocks.purpose: Eliminate all artificial ambience and keep the sound dry.
blocks.gap: The target tone requires minimal to zero reverb/ambience.

blocks.purpose: Control the overall output level for a controlled, intimate performance feel.

improvements.summary: Focus on IR selection to enhance close-mic, natural acoustic detail.

proposals.reason: Enhance the realism of a close-mic, dry acoustic recording.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased natural string detail and clarity.
